# Sound effects

“Oculus Audio Pack 01” by Oculus VR, LLC (https://developers.meta.com/vr/downloads/package/oculus-audio-pack-1/), licensed under CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Files renamed to the UCS naming convention; OGG previews transcoded from the original WAVs. Ember Vault excerpts, normalizes, fades and converts selected footsteps and sword clash to MP3.

SFX Kit original effects by Wyzowl (https://github.com/wyzowl/sfx-kit), CC0 1.0. Ember Vault excerpts, normalizes, fades and converts selected effects to MP3.

Full file mappings and checksums: docs/production/SFX-SOURCES.json in the source repository.
